name: Fresh water (river, lake)
notes: River and lake margins: willow and alder on banks, cattail/reed/bulrush emergents in the shallows, water lilies and floating plants on still water, and submerged pondweed/water milfoil below. Drawn on temperate Eurasia and North America with tropical lakes (Amazon, African Rift) for lotus and giant water lily; underwater species flagged.
